description: End-to-end recommendation cases for the baseline and the agent. Frozen once it has results: changes go in recommend_v2.

cases.note: No request and no flags: pure recommendation from the library.
Kafka regression (F-001) and two hard filters from flags.
Tone preference with no number: no page filter may be invented.

cases.request: una distopía de menos de 400 páginas en inglés
cases.note: A genre plus two filters from the text.
A read book used as a reference: it must never be recommended.

cases.request: A fantasy book around 700 pages with great magic system, but nothing from Brandon Sanderson
cases.note: "Around 700" is not a hard filter; an author exclusion the validator can't check yet.

cases.request: Libros de cuentos similares a Jorge Luis Borges, en español
cases.note: A read reference author, a format (short stories) and a Spanish language filter.
Nearly impossible: few unread books by the author; tests the turn budget (F-007, F-008).

cases.request: A sci fi book that is not about space

cases.note: Origin, not language: no language filter.

cases.request: no ficción sobre historia, menos de 300 páginas
cases.note: Non-fiction with a hard filter from the text.
A niche genre with thin catalog coverage and hallucination risk.

cases.request: algo corto y liviano en español
cases.note: Spanish language filter; the baseline produced broken JSON and a hallucinated title here (F-002).
